notes.redis: Deliberate public dependency: Orm::redis_client and Orm::redis_manager (redis feature) hand the application the ORM's own Redis client and connection manager.
notes.tower-sessions: Only through Connect's opt-in axum-session feature: its extractors read the Session that the application's SessionManagerLayer inserts, so both must use the same line.
notes.validator: Only the Validate trait and derive, which the application's #[derive(Validate)] implements through its own validator dependency; ValidationError carries Rullst's FieldErrors since 13.0.0-alpha.6.
